candidate_eligibility_all: Both paths are regular top-level non-reparse files under current known Downloads
Only suffix (N).zip whose same-folder unsuffixed base .zip exists; N is a positive integer
Both source and retained base are >=24 hours old at decision time
Both paths appeared unchanged in two successful scans separated by >=60 minutes
Both paths have equal nonzero length and equal independently recomputed full SHA256
Source full-file identity and complete ownership/dependency evidence are current before action
Canonical unsuffixed base remains in Downloads; never move final retained copy
Current installed-application/repository/service/task/toolchain attribution finds no protected or unknown dependency
Exact source remains identity-and-content-stable when handle-bound same-volume quarantine rename is attempted
Distinct locally persisted operator standing authorization matches this exact policy version, mode, scope, expiry and limits, and explicit repository approval-flow extension is approved and tested
always_skip: REPOSITORY_OR_WORKTREE: any Git/Entire source/checkout, nested project, unpushed or shared dependency
PATH_REDIRECTION: symbolic link, junction, mount point, reparse, cloud placeholder, crossing a volume
NOT_EXACT_DUPLICATE: version-similar but byte-different files, alternate names, suffix without retained original, hash mismatch
STALE: changed since baseline or immediately before bound file-handle operation

before_enable: Extend docs/agent/LOCAL-AGENT-PROTECTIONS.md and exact-manifest approval contracts only through an explicitly operator-authorized governance change
Persist non-Agent-created, scope/version/expiry/action-bound standing authorization under ignored private runtime
Derive each per-run manifest deterministically; bind its digest, item set, policy version and fresh ownership graph to a separately validated authorization receipt
Refuse self-approval without an accepted and independently validated standing-rule authority source
Require current preflight, handle-bound atomic same-volume move, per-item receipt and restore proof before enabling
